shortDescription: Module interacting with slurmctld using scontrol

options.name: new_state
options.description: If specified, new_state will be configured at nodes. available states DOWN,DRAIN,FAIL,FUTURE,NORESP,POWER_DOWN,POWER_DOWN_ASAP,POWER_DOWN_FORCE,POWER_UP,RESUME,UNDRAIN.

options.name: new_state_reason
options.description: Reason to be used together with "drain" state eg. 'node maintenance'

options.name: nodes
options.description: List of nodes for the purpose of reading or modifying their states.
